jobs.prompt: Golden hour on a dusty Nigerian residential street, cinematic anime style. A young Nigerian woman with long braided hair wearing a teal patterned dress stands in the middle of the road. She turns her head toward the camera, then begins walking slowly along the dusty roadside toward a yellow danfo bus parked at the curb. Dust motes drift through warm amber light, laundry sways on lines strung between buildings. Halfway through she pauses beside a corrugated fence, glances back over her shoulder once, then keeps walking. She reaches the bus door, rests her hand on it and looks up with a faint hopeful smile. Camera: one continuous slow tracking shot that follows her walk, drifting from a medium shot into a close-up on her face as she reaches the bus. Shallow depth of field, warm amber grade, consistent character.
